meta.title: Roger Football Coaching — Hillsborough County, FL
meta.description: Professional football coaching in Brandon, FL. Training sessions for youth and high school athletes.

about.name: Coach Roger
about.bio: The lineman is the very foundation of the unit. Without the line, nothing can be accomplished. To be successful in the trenches, you must beat your opponent physically, mentally, and psychologically. O & D line are the true skill positions. From TE to TE and DE to DE.

hero.headline: Hillsborough County's Premier Football Coach
hero.subline: Personalized football training that turns potential into performance.

testimonials.quote: Coach Roger has a gift for breaking down the fundamentals. My kid went from nervous on the field to one of the most confident players on the team.
testimonials.name: Derrick M.

testimonials.quote: Nobody pushes me the right way like Coach Roger does. Every session I leave better than I came.
testimonials.name: Jordan R.

copy_variants.about_tagline: BUILT IN THE TRENCHES. FORGED FOR THE SPOTLIGHT.
